HOW IT WORKS

title.value: Self-cleaning filtration that keeps performance stable

paragraph.value: ECO AIR captures oil mist and emulsions directly at the source, separates them mechanically, and recycles collected oil—without disposable filter mats.
Contaminated air is drawn directly from the machine.
Mechanical filtration and coalescence remove oil mist and droplets.
Integrated nozzles clean the system automatically and return collected oil for reuse.

title.value: Electrostatic filtration for smoke and fine aerosols

paragraph.value: EARIA captures smoke and fine aerosols using electrostatic filtration, then cleans the collector cells automatically to maintain consistent airflow.
Contaminated air enters the filtration unit.
Electrostatic cells charge and capture fine particles.
The system automatically cleans the collector cells to maintain performance.
